flow:
flowchart LR
  Cart[Cart] --> Signed{Signed in?}
  Signed -- yes --> Pay[Payment]
  Signed -- no --> Login[Log in]
  Login --> Pay
  Pay --> Stock{In stock?}
  Stock -- yes --> Ship([Ship it])
  Stock -- no --> Notify[Email me later]
seq:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as You
  participant A as App
  participant S as Server
  U->>A: Tap "Log in"
  A->>S: POST /session
  S-->>A: 200 + token
  A-->>U: Welcome back
  Note over A,S: token kept for 30 days
state:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Red
  Red --> Green: timer 30s
  Green --> Yellow: timer 25s
  Yellow --> Red: timer 5s
  Red --> Flashing: power fault
  Flashing --> Red: reset
big:
flowchart TD
  Order[Order placed] --> Valid{Valid address?}
  Valid -- no --> Fix[Ask customer to fix] --> Valid
  Valid -- yes --> Fraud{Fraud check}
  Fraud -- flagged --> Review[Manual review]
  Review -- reject --> Cancel[Cancel order]
  Review -- approve --> Pay
  Fraud -- clear --> Pay{Payment}
  Pay -- declined --> Retry[Retry card] --> Pay
  Pay -- paid --> Stock{In stock?}
  Stock -- no --> Backorder[Backorder]
  Backorder --> Notify[Email customer]
  Notify --> Wait[Wait for stock] --> Stock
  Stock -- partial --> Split[Split shipment]
  Stock -- yes --> Pick[Pick items]
  Split --> Pick
  Pick --> Pack[Pack box]
  Pack --> Weigh{Over 20 kg?}
  Weigh -- yes --> Freight[Freight carrier]
  Weigh -- no --> Parcel[Parcel carrier]
  Freight --> Label[Print label]
  Parcel --> Label
  Label --> Ship[Hand to carrier]
  Ship --> Track[Tracking email]
  Track --> Transit{Delivered?}
  Transit -- lost --> Claim[Carrier claim] --> Reship[Reship]
  Reship --> Pick
  Transit -- yes --> Delivered[Delivered]
  Delivered --> Return{Return requested?}
  Return -- no --> Done([Done])
  Return -- yes --> RMA[Issue RMA]
  RMA --> Receive[Receive return]
  Receive --> Inspect{Resellable?}
  Inspect -- yes --> Restock[Restock] --> Refund
  Inspect -- no --> Writeoff[Write off] --> Refund[Refund]
  Refund --> Done
  Cancel --> Done
